final: WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a FROM c), j AS (SELECT c.account_id, cu.town_city, c.n FROM c JOIN Accounts ac ON ac.account_id = c.account_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE cu.town_city IS NOT NULL AND cu.town_city <> ''), t AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(n) AS tn FROM j GROUP BY town_city) SELECT j.account_id, j.town_city, j.n AS num_transactions, j.n * 1.0 / t.tn AS share_of_town, j.n / avgc.a AS ratio_to_avg FROM j JOIN t ON t.town_city = j.town_city CROSS JOIN avgc ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC, j.account_id LIMIT 10
